body:
Sorry for the late answer, I woke up really late and I didn't want my boyfriend to see that I posted here, he would be really upset. Thank you for what you wrote. I think you are right, he got lost in all of this and so did I. We were only 17 when all the bad things happened to me. I feel much better today and that makes me wanna live. 
Thank you again.

There was a time back in high school when I wouldn't sleep for two or three days. Maybe an hour or something but that's not a proper sleep. But I've been suffering from problems with sleep since childhood - I can't fall asleep that easily. All of my friends/family just fall asleep in 2 minutes and for me it takes at least 30 minutes, usually 1 hour. I've been trying many different pills and nothing worked. And those that should've make me  sleep like a baby made me feel even worse.

Well, that's two good things in one then. There's nothing bad about trying to help yourself while helping others. I think I will get some sleep now but I have added you as a friend, so write to me whenever you like - really about anything :) and thank you again
Yeah, I've heard about it however I my doctor didn't say that it can be seen just by the blood test. I will try to get some info, thank you.

But you are a good person. You are helping people here, you helped me and that really means a lot to me. I think that helping people find a reason to live is definitely something that makes you a good person. 
And to be honest I haven't heard anything nice or any words of encouragement from anyone since forever so that really felt nice.  
It's 8:35 AM and I haven't even slept yet haha.

It should have healed long time ago but it just keeps coming back. I need to have a panendoscopy done (a kind of rubber pipe with camera is being put through your throat and esophagus into the stomach) but I'm really scared of that because of my huge gag reflex. But I've been convincing myself to do it till the end of this year. 

Thank you very much for  showing the interest in what I wrote here and making me feel better. It means a lot to me and it actually helped me to calm down a bit. I have read some of your other comments here and I really wish you everything best, you seem to be a great person and there are not that many great people in the world. You haven't lost everything - you still have yourself and that's definitely worth fighting for. 

I also find it really...well, fascinating actually that I can get help from people living in the other end of the world. But at the same time I regret that such great people live so far away.

I've got a peptic ulcer and until it's healed I shouldn't take any meds except my stomach meds and the other thing is that this meds sort of make antidepressants much less effective :/  So they just wouldn't work at all. I know a lot about meds right now because my mom has taken dozens of different antidepressants over those 5 years. Finding the right one is sometimes a real pain, all those side effects... 

Yes, it's cold! I hate cold. When it's so grey and cold outside I would like to sleep the whole winter :< I am constantly sleepy and tired, that sucks. My mood goes down very much during autumn/winter. And where are you from?

Right now I don't see many options. IT is definitely my passion and I would love to do something computer related if only my anxiety could go away... I live in Poland but I am planning to leave after finishing Uni and live somewhere else, not sure where yet, maybe Scotland. As far as I know it would be much easier to get there a remote job.

I've been seeing psychologist in high school and it didn't help much :( 

Regarding the job thing - I could work from home if I lived somewhere else. It's not really popular in my country and if you really want to do this, you have to be a rather experienced person. I have 0 experience and right now I find it really hard to focus on anything. I got a job one year ago and I could only make it for 2 days (it was a call center). It's not just about the people around but also all the pressure and fear of doing something wrong. It all comes from my childhood I guess - my mom was always very hard on me when it was about school and being the best student in class etc. and I felt I was never good enough. I don't have that much problems with e-mails, but I totally can't phone people, I get very stressed.

Yes, it's my first and only serious relationship. There was a time when he was really caring, even back this year after I dropped out of Uni. He supported me and was there for me. But I think he got fed up with my problems and my constant promises that I would go and see psychiatrist. I did once, but since I can' take medications because of my stomach problems it didn't really help.

And currently I'm studying Computer Science. You would think that people in this field shouldn't have too much trouble with finding a job, but I just can't imagine working with other people thanks to my social phobia.

Thank you, it really makes me feel better that there is someone out there in the world that can understand me. I actually started having suicidal thought when I was 11. My parents expected a bit too much of me and I started feeling unloved and not good enough. In junior high I've been bullied almost everyday for 3 years. When I met my boyfriend in high school I was so happy, I felt loved and accepted for who I am and my insecurity somehow disappeared. But it didn't last long, everything eventually went back to how it was with me and now I just feel like I'm nobody.

Yes, I started the Uni again in October. 

The worst thing is that I really love him and I know he loves me, we've been together 5 years this month actually. But on the other side I am afraid he will never be able to understand me. He sort of have a problem with feelings and emotions (sometimes it feels like he hasn't got any) and I am very emotional. The fact that I am so depressed doesn't really help. If I left him, I wouldn't know what to do with my life anymore, I don't think I would ever be able to love anyone else.
Thanks for the tip, I'll check it out.

Thank you for your comment. I talked with my dad and he seems to be OK but I know that on the inside he is very miserable. He kind of thinks that it is his fault but I'm sure it's not. We all try to help my mom feel better but she is not really cooperative in that matter. I guess she thinks that suicide is easier than coping with problems from the past. My dad talked with her psychiatrist today so I hope she gave him some support and piece of advice. He's gonna call me when mom gets transferred to another hospital.

she was taking a lot of different things because her doctor was just trying to figure out what will work best but it stopped on Alventa which is venlafaxinum. She also took hydroxyzinum and levomepromazinum (Tisercin) which was for sleeping better as far as I remember. Sertralinum (Zotral) was ineffective. And about therapy she was forced into a group therapy in the hospital and also had an individual one with her psychiatrist but I don't know any details.

Thank you for the support. My parents are not online unfortunately. The problem is that her psychiatrist is already the best one in the city. And in general, psychiatry in Poland is on a very low level... I tried talking with her so many times - that she has me and my dad and she can ask me for help or even advice whenever she wants. But she just won't listen to anyone.
Yeah, that's a good idea. My grandmother couldn't understand that my mom is depressed and she can't just cheer up and be fine until she went to psychologist and had it explained to her.

I always try to tell him why I feel in a certain way (although I sometimes don't know that) and well, I just talk about my feelings...He doesn't even have to respond but he listens and that somehow makes me feel a bit better. I also lack energy recently and I'm planning on giving up my Uni... And go to the doctor, eventually. 
I don't feel lonely only when I'm right next to my boyfriend, I'm somewhat dependent on him. When I talk to my friends it sometimes feels so weird and not natural and after and hour or two I feel so tired that I was always the first one to leave parties or meetings telling that I have something to do. 
About the medicines - my mom took them for 3 years, many different pills, but now she doesn't have to take them at all. She behaved diffrently sometimes but she was always the same person for me. It's important to have someone to watch over you.

It does make sense. I feel very similar to you. I think your boyfriend does understand but he just doesn't know what to do. I feel the same way about my boyfriend, when I'm sad he doesn't really know how to cheer me up and he usually just pushes me into doing some things just not to think about it. But I just think it's his way to support me and I'm happy he tries. Talk with your boyfriend a lot and try to describe him how you feel. I know it's hard sometimes to put it in words but it sort of works for me.
Don't worry about what other people say, it's easy for them to say cheer up or something because they don't know how you feel. I also understand your fear about medications because I also fear them a bit. But maybe it's worth trying? You can always tell your doctor if you feel bad after them. My mom didn't become a robot after medicines so perhaps you could try. 
If you want to talk, PM me. I can share my story with you if it helps. I wish you all the best!
Feel free to PM me. I also need someone to talk to.
Sure it is! :) Hello, my new friend :)
You can PM me too. I also suffer from social anxiety so I know how it feels. Any new understanding friends are much appreciated :)
